patterns: Single-fact items dominate: founder (Nagabhata I), greatest king (Mihira Bhoja), title Adivaraha, Rajashekhara's patron (Mahendrapala I).
Chronological ordering of rulers (Vatsaraja -> Nagabhata II -> Mahendrapala -> Mahipala) and odd-one-out lists (Bhartribhata not Pratihara).
Arab travellers: Sulaiman visited in Bhoja I's reign; Al-Masudi's 'Baura'; parentage trap (grandson, not son, of Nagabhata II).
No APPSC PYQ on this topic is genuine; app MCQs are deeper than other-PSC PYQs but mostly sound.
